### NAME

`kind` - kind — Kubernetes IN Docker, local clusters for testing.

### SYNOPSIS & usage

*Derived from the upstream README at generation
time; verify against `--help` where the tool is
installed.*

```
# For AMD64 / x86_64
[ $(uname -m) = x86_64 ] && curl -Lo ./kind https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/dl/v0.33.0/kind-$(uname)-amd64
# For ARM64
[ $(uname -m) = aarch64 ] && curl -Lo ./kind https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/dl/v0.33.0/kind-$(uname)-arm64
chmod +x ./kind
sudo mv ./kind /usr/local/bin/kind
```

```
brew install kind
```

### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

kind is a tool for running local Kubernetes clusters using Docker container "nodes". kind was primarily designed for testing Kubernetes itself, but may be used for local development or CI. If you have [go] and [docker], [podman] or [nerdctl] installed `go install sigs.k8s.io/kind@v0.33.0 && kind create cluster` is all you need! kind consists of: - Go [packages][packages] implementing [cluster creation][cluster package], [image build][build package], etc. - A command line interface ([`kind`][kind cli]) built on these packages. - Docker [image(s)][images] written to run systemd, Kubernetes, etc. - [`kubetest`][kubetest] integration also built on these packages (WIP) kind bootstraps each "node"
